create_NamedOptimizer: create a _NamedOptimizer wrapping an optimizer with fully qualified parameter name mappings
build_state_dict: build a FQN-keyed state dict from the _NamedOptimizer instead of numeric indices
run_step: run a single optimization step on the _NamedOptimizer with an optional closure
load_state_dict: load a FQN-keyed optimizer state dict into the _NamedOptimizer with validation
add_param_group: add a parameter group to the _NamedOptimizer with FQN-mapped parameters
